trigger: Plays when finding Mansukh and Manya bickering about typography in the prop warehouse.

lines.speaker: mansukh
lines.text: I told you, Manya! The letter-spacing on 'CINEMA' is two pixels too wide!

lines.speaker: manya
lines.text: Who cares about two pixels of kerning when the entire title is BEIGE?!

lines.speaker: mansukh
lines.text: Babymonnsterrr! Bad kerning is a human rights violation! Always baiting 💔

lines.speaker: manya
lines.text: Needs more saturation! Look, Ashwath and Sayam survived the render farm!

lines.speaker: mansukh
lines.text: Babymonnsterrr! Lightstick ready, headphones on. Let's draw vector bridges.

lines.speaker: manya
lines.text: And my paint bucket is loaded. Red for solid, yellow for bounce. Let's go.
